verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: service accounts, the scriptable op CLI, SDKs and the Credential Broker give external CI/CD or scripts access to secrets. Nothing shows 1Password itself letting a user define, schedule or run autonomous background automations. A user's own pipelines calling these primitives do not count as the product delivering the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
